description.p: Stack is an independent document library for the COSMIC desktop. Import documents, organize them into stacks, search printed English text offline, and keep saved changes in sync with an approved nearby Android phone.
Documents are stored locally. No account or cloud service is required.

Updates now arrive through your app store or flatpak update. Pairing certificates are created inside Stack, phone sync uses TLS 1.3 only, and a safety copy of the library is saved before changes from the phone are applied.
Syncing with the phone uses much less processing when nothing has changed.
